meta.scope: Correct S823 validation.calibration after distinguishing model calibration from stimulus dosimetry

records.title: ROS-mediated activation of Drosophila larval nociceptor neurons by UVC irradiation

searches.query: PMC3898224 validation.calibration applicability and UVC exposure details

validation.notes: Full open-access PMC primary text and exact PubMed identity reviewed. UVC stimulus is 0.17, 1.2, or 8 mW/cm2 for 5 s in Fig. 1; UVA/UVB and a separate 45-46 C heat assay are distinct. Fig. 4 reports direct extracellular v'ada mdIV electrophysiology after UVC. Writhing is visually scored larval behavior; mdIV inactivation suppresses it (Fig. 1), and antioxidant manipulations support ROS involvement (Figs. 2 and 5). Fig. 1 sample n counts trials of five larvae, not individual animals. No subjective-pain or human transfer inference. Stimulus intensity and duration describe exposure dosimetry, not predictive-model calibration; this mechanistic study has no model-calibration analysis.

validation.calibration.reason: Calibration is a predictive-model or forecast property; this mechanistic experiment has no predictive model. UVC intensity and duration are reported separately as stimulus dosimetry, not calibration.
